name: dumbbell one arm triceps extension on stability ball
description: Overhead triceps extension with one dumbbell while seated on a stability ball. The ball adds a core challenge.
instructions: Sit tall on a stability ball and hold a dumbbell overhead in one hand.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Bend your elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
